line: Crowley's Nine of Swords is the card for the second decan of Gemini, with Mars as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Gemini.

quotes.quote: The Nine of Swords is called Cruelty.
The celestial ruler is Mars in Gemini

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: The Swords no longer represent pure intellect so much as the automatic stirring of heartless passions.
